schema_description: The openEHR Reference Model 1.2.0 as openehr-sdk-go generates it: the pinned openehr_rm_1.2.0 schema, with the corrections it lacks until a re-pin carries them.

TRANSLATION_DETAILS.name: TRANSLATION_DETAILS
TRANSLATION_DETAILS.documentation:
Class providing details of a natural language translation.

Reason: the RM schema misspells the name of the accreditation property, which the openEHR BASE, ITS-XML and ITS-JSON schemas spell accreditation, so the class is declared again whole under that name. Upstream: https://github.com/openEHR/specifications-RM/pull/43.

language.name: language
language.documentation:
Language of the translation.

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.

author.name: author
author.documentation:
Translator name and other demographic details.

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.

accreditation.name: accreditation
accreditation.documentation:
Accreditation of translator, usually a national translator's registration or association membership id.

Reason: the RM schema misspells this name; the openEHR BASE, ITS-XML and ITS-JSON schemas spell it accreditation. Upstream: https://github.com/openEHR/specifications-RM/pull/43.

other_details.name: other_details
other_details.documentation:
Any other meta-data.

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.

ROLE.name: ROLE
ROLE.documentation:
Generic description of a role performed by an Actor. The role corresponds to a competency of the Party. Roles are used to define the responsibilities undertaken by a Party for a purpose. Roles should have credentials qualifying the performer to perform the role. A Role without a performer is a generic role: a kind of role, or a post, that any number of Actors may play.

Reason: the RM schema makes performer mandatory, so a role that many Actors share cannot be recorded; the class is declared again whole with performer optional. Upstream: https://openehr.atlassian.net/browse/SPECRM-134, https://github.com/openEHR/specifications-RM/pull/48.

time_validity.name: time_validity
time_validity.documentation:
Valid time interval for this role.

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.

performer.name: performer
performer.documentation:
Reference to Version container of Actor playing the role. Void if the role is generic, i.e. not bound to one Actor; the Actors playing a generic role refer to it through ACTOR.roles.

Reason: the RM schema makes this property mandatory; a generic role has no single performer. Upstream: https://openehr.atlassian.net/browse/SPECRM-134, https://github.com/openEHR/specifications-RM/pull/48.

capabilities.name: capabilities
capabilities.documentation:
The capabilities of this role.

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.
